about: The source line is an indented '    - [?] …' bullet under an untagged parent. Writing its pointer also turns '- [?] ' into '- ': the four-space indent, the words, and the tag stay, and the pointer goes at the end. The parent line is untouched. pointed_lines holds the line without [?]. The real Edit guard gives [], explaining the removed [?] together with the pointer.
